pairs.key: ForgeCraft specific block. It will be replaced later

pairs.key: Place on something like Magma Blocks or Fluix Blocks to produce Xynergy. Currently, Xynergy is only used for the hover pylon in game which will need to be bound to this block or other nodes with a stick or `c:tools/wrench`.

pairs.key: Provides flight while in a powered Hover Pylon field
pairs.value: 在有供能的悬浮基柱力场内时提供飞行能力

pairs.value: 你不能将其绑定到自身
